name: Treaty with the Cherokee, March 22, 1816 (cession to South Carolina)
promises: Article 2: the United States promised that South Carolina would pay the Cherokee Nation $5,000 within ninety days after ratification, provided the nation sanctioned the treaty in council and South Carolina approved.
today: No court, Indian Claims Commission or Court of Claims finding about this cession was located.

sources.title: Treaty with the Cherokee, 1816 (7 Stat. 138)
sources.publisher: Oklahoma State University Libraries, Tribal Treaties Database (Kappler)

sources.title: Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule p. 680

openQuestions: Whether South Carolina paid the $5,000 was not confirmed.
A second Cherokee treaty of the same day (7 Stat. 139) deals with boundaries and roads; this record is the South Carolina cession (Royce area 76).
The Cherokee Nation's own account of this cession was not located.

2026-11-08 sweep: Court of Claims and ICC full text searched for Cherokee (Court of Claims index; every pre-1946 Cherokee case grepped for 1816) and 'Cherokee South Carolina 1816', 'Cherokee March 22, 1816' (ICC); nothing on this cession.
